subtopics.title: 802.11 Architecture: BSS, APs, and Channels
subtopics.summary: Covers the 802.11 standards family (b/g/n/ac/ax, branded WiFi 4/5/6), the basic service set (BSS), access points, channels and SSIDs, and how a station associates with an AP in a 'WiFi jungle' with multiple overlapping APs.

subtopics.title: 802.11 MAC Protocol (CSMA/CA)
subtopics.summary: Explains the 802.11 medium access protocol, including CSMA/CA with random backoff, link-layer acknowledgments, and how it differs from Ethernet's CSMA/CD.

subtopics.title: IEEE 802.11 Frame Format
subtopics.summary: Describes the structure of 802.11 frames, including the address fields (which can differ from Ethernet addressing), frame types (data, control, management), and how frames are exchanged between a wireless host and an AP.

subtopics.title: Mobility in the Same IP Subnet
subtopics.summary: Examines how a wireless station hands over between access points within the same IP subnet, including association/reassociation and switch self-learning to keep the session intact.

subtopics.title: Advanced 802.11 Features
subtopics.summary: Covers advanced capabilities in 802.11 such as rate adaptation and power management, plus features like the WiFi Positioning System (WPS).

subtopics.title: Bluetooth Personal Area Networks
subtopics.summary: Introduces Bluetooth as a wireless personal area network technology, covering its architecture (piconets) and how it complements 802.11 WLANs.
